ranking_by: height of the tallest measured tree
title: The 5 Tallest Tree Species, Ranked (#1 Is 30 Stories High)

scenes.text: The five tallest tree species, ranked. Two grow on the other side of the world.

scenes.label: Yellow meranti · 97.6 m
scenes.text: Number five: the yellow meranti. Nearly ninety-eight meters tall, in a rainforest in Borneo.

scenes.label: Douglas-fir · 99.5 m
scenes.text: Number four: the coast Douglas-fir. About ninety-nine and a half meters, measured in an Oregon forest.

scenes.label: Sitka spruce · 100.2 m
scenes.text: Number three: the Sitka spruce. Just over one hundred meters, found in California's Redwood National Park.

scenes.label: Tibetan cypress · 102.3 m
scenes.text: Number two: the South Tibetan cypress. About one hundred two meters, growing in a deep canyon in Tibet.

scenes.label: Coast redwood · 116 m
scenes.text: Number one: Hyperion, a coast redwood. One hundred sixteen meters, about thirty stories high.

description:
The five tallest tree species, ranked by the tallest tree measured.
From a Borneo rainforest to a Tibetan canyon to a California redwood that stands about thirty stories high.
Which would you want to climb?
first_comment: Which tree would you put at #1 and what should we rank next?
